title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me to Eurydike, the roofless hall of the Kothringi knights north of Gideon, to open the knight-captain's tomb with the keystone; the knights once guarded the kings' road to the Root, the place under the sea where every Hist's roots meet and the Eye of Argonia lies. The knights' dead walk the barracks wing, and the Unbound got there before me. I'm to search the Unbound's packs by their fire on the way to the tomb. I may fight, slip past, or turn the dead with Restoration.
objectives: Search the Unbound's packs in Eurydike's barracks wing. (marker: Unbound Pack)

plan.going: The keystone opens the knight-captain's tomb at Eurydike; the Unbound are there ahead of me.
plan.next: Go to Eurydike and search the Unbound's packs on the way to the tomb.
plan.ways: Fight the dead and the Unbound, slip past them, or turn the dead with Restoration.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka. I am at Eurydike, a roofless Kothringi hall near Gideon, to open the knight-captain tomb with the keystone before the Unbound and the Collector. The captain was buried with what marked the kings road to the Root. The Unbound are already here and the knights dead walk the barracks wing.
Search the Unbound packs in the barracks wing (marker: Unbound Pack), then go to the tomb door.
Fight the Restless Knight and the Unbound Digger, slip past, or turn the dead with Restoration.
I do not understand what the Root and the Eye of Argonia really are, or how Nesh-Deeka knows what she knows. I might learn by reading what I find here and asking people.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: In the Unbound's packs were bottles of the grey paste they call "the seal". It is a paralysis poison: it numbs a tree's scar shut. The Unbound drain a tree and then poison it. If they wanted the trees dead they could kill them, so why seal a tree they drain? I'm to open the knight-captain's tomb with the keystone.
objectives: Open the knight-captain's tomb with the keystone and search it. (marker: Door to Knight-Captain's Tomb, Knight-Captain's Tomb Chest)

plan.going: The seal is a paralysis poison. I do not know why the Unbound seal trees they drain: that question is open.
plan.next: Open the tomb with the keystone and search the knight-captain's chest.
plan.ways: The keystone is the door's key; the dead and the Unbound may still be about.
terms: paralysis poison (the seal): the item's name and journal 20

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka. I cleared the digger and the dead knight at Eurydike and found Unbound bottles of grey seal, a paralysis poison used to numb a tree scar shut after they drain it.
Open the knight-captain tomb door with the keystone and search the chest inside.
Use the keystone on the door; the lock may also be pickable. I could also keep the poison.
I do not understand why the Unbound drain and then seal trees, or what the Root and the Eye are. I might learn from the tomb contents or from Nesh-Deeka.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: In the knight-captain's tomb lay a bronze disc stamped with a mine's mark, a pick crossed with a tower. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the bronze disc to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: The disc bears a mine's mark; I do not know which mine.

answers: I opened the knight-captain tomb with the keystone and took a bronze disc stamped with a pick crossed with a tower, a mine mark. It is what marked the kings road to the Root, I think.
Bring the disc to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Go straight to her, or keep the disc and look into the mark first; I also have gold and the other items.
I do not know which mine the mark belongs to, nor what the Root and Eye really are. Nesh-Deeka may tell me.

title: The Knights' Tomb
journal: Nesh-Deeka knew the mark: Vicrium, an old mine in the clay country behind Seafalls, in the east. She already knew the Unbound had been at Eurydike. Before I could ask how, she said "we listen" and would not answer why they seal the trees. She paid me 100 gold. The question stays with me.

plan.going: The disc points to Vicrium. Why the Unbound seal the trees is still open; Nesh-Deeka knows where they go and will not say how.
plan.next: MN10 starts; its first entry marks Vicrium.
terms: Vicrium: Nesh-Deeka: an old mine behind Seafalls in Okuwun Rahei

answers: Notes: I work for Nesh-Deeka (Toh-Reel-Ka, Helstrom). I opened the knight-captain tomb at Eurydike with the Kothringi Keystone, killed the Unbound digger and the restless knight, took 3 Grey Seal paralysis poisons from the Unbound pack (the Unbound drain trees then numb the scar shut with it, and I do not know why), and took the bronze disc. I gave it to Nesh-Deeka. The mark, a pick and tower, is Vicrium, an old ochre and alum mine in the clay country behind Seafalls in Okuwun Rahei in the east; the knights kept a strongbox there. This is a step to the Eye of Argonia at the Root. She was paid me 100 gold again, so I have about 800. She knew the Unbound were at Eurydike and only said "we listen"; how she knows stays unanswered. I still carry the Pale Harvest strongbox key, Old Silver Setting, The Collector note, smuggler key. Next: go to Vicrium near Seafalls before the Unbound and the Collector (Ennodius Vanin). Unknown: what the Root and the Eye really are, why trees are sealed, how Nesh-Deeka knows things.
